unresolvedReview.notice: Published with unresolved editorial review findings, listed below. The review ran and recorded them; since 2026-08-04 a stylistic or topical finding does not stop publication. The checks that the article is accurate still do: supplied source links, cited sources, source diversity, primary sourcing, watchlist support and the cost caps.

verdicts.reason: Hands using a specialized tool to work on a green PCB; genuine, well-composed technical work that feels authentic and illustrates the hardware and troubleshooting dimension of AI infrastructure.

candidates.reason: Shows hands soldering electronics, which references hardware/AI infrastructure, but the mid-2000s composition and warm color cast feel aesthetically dated and specific to a repair moment rather than illustrating AI system failures.
A circuit-board-shaped brain is a clichéd, heavily styled stock illustration that screams 'AI art' and fails the freshness test entirely.
Museum or exhibition display of circuit boards is interesting but illustrates electronics history or education, not AI failures or system malfunctions.
Overlaid glowing faces on circuit board is a stock visualization trope from circa 2015–2018 and looks digitally constructed rather than documentary.
candidates.sceneCs: obličeje promítnuté přes desku plošných spojů

candidates.reason: Neon-lit, heavily stylized chip shot with blue and magenta gradients is a hallmark of mid-to-late 2010s AI marketing imagery and feels overwrought and artificial.
Abstract infographic of figures and charts with holographic/digital overlays feels like a generic 'data' stock image and lacks concrete connection to the failure scenarios described.
candidates.sceneCs: abstraktní infografika s figurami a daty

candidates.reason: Real motherboard with heat sinks shows genuine hardware but is slightly out of focus and the composition is generic—relevant to infrastructure but not specifically illustrative of AI failure.
Hands working on a green PCB with a soldering tool; realistic, well-lit, and shows hands-on hardware work that can legitimately represent AI system maintenance or troubleshooting.
Hands assembling or repairing a blue-green motherboard with visible connectors; clean, well-lit, and shows actual technical work on hardware that underpins AI systems.
candidates.sceneCs: ruce pracující s deskou plošných spojů

candidates.reason: Hands inserting or removing a component on a green motherboard in good light; realistic, competent-looking technical work that illustrates the infrastructure layer of AI systems.
Hands using a specialized tool to work on a green PCB; genuine, well-composed technical work that feels authentic and illustrates the hardware and troubleshooting dimension of AI infrastructure.
candidates.sceneCs: ruce s nástrojem na desce plošných spojů

candidates.reason: A person with a recognisable face (red glasses, visible identity) holding a motherboard is a fatal veto: the article is not about this individual, and the image presents them as a subject or expert rather than illustrating the topic abstractly.
candidates.sceneCs: osoba se zvýrazněnou tváří drží desku
